concept: mcp-compressor wrapper proxy in front of a local-model agent
summary: The model first sees a small compressed surface, asks for the full schema of one tool, then invokes it.

facts.text: The model first sees a small compressed surface, asks for the full schema of one tool, then invokes it.
Pattern 1 is a wrapper in front of any MCP client; pattern 2 is a local session proxy for SDKs and generated clients, which call it with a session token and need no stdio subprocess.
